🎮 Xbox Game Pass closes out November with 3 new games!

Here's what's landing before the month ends:
🕹️ MOTORSLICE — moves from Ultimate down to the cheaper Premium tier (Nov 24)
🎯 Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 — joins Ultimate, PC & Premium tiers (Nov 24), now bundled with the new "Butcher's Banquet" expansion
⚔️ Arkheron — the only day-one launch, entering Early Access on Ultimate & PC Game Pass (Nov 27). A fast-paced team PvP game with a Tower to climb

🕒 Published 15:00 (GMT+3)

📰 Sources: Pure Xbox

👥 x.com/Xbox, x.com/XboxGamePass

💬 Which of these three are you adding to your queue? Drop a comment below!
